post_interview_reconciliation.original_question: Recall co-displays conflicting memories and their citations. When an approved current decision exists, it is marked as the winner while superseded/conflicting evidence remains visible.
post_interview_reconciliation.reconciliation: The supported conflict state contract is OPEN or RESOLVED; supersession is represented by RESOLVED and SUPERSEDED is rejected. The validated service snapshot now carries a signed unverified_conflicts marker binding a displayed approved winner to a withheld approved citationless counterpart without violating the exactly-one-citation-per-displayed-candidate invariant. Application conversion transfers the marker to the runtime and the CLI/library renderer exposes it. Contrary citations accumulate without overwrite.
